data.standardized_narrative: At 1 January 2022 gross claims outstanding were $566.8m. During 2022 management recorded an increase in prior year provisions of $88.7m gross (approximately 15.6% of opening gross claims outstanding) indicating an adverse prior-year development (strengthening). The annual report also notes favourable attritional improvements in 2020 and prior-year reserves from the perspective of the 2020 year-of-account result (this refers to net/reinsured impacts). The 2022 underwriting year was driven by several major catastrophe events (Hurricane Ian, eastern Australian floods, derecho events) and the Russia/Ukraine conflict which affected underwriting performance and reserve positioning.
raw_causal_phrases: Following an extensive review of loss reserves in Q4 2022, the Syndicate has benefited from favourable attritional improvements in 2020 and prior year loss reserves, which have contributed to the 2020 Year of Account result.
The market experienced another active loss year in 2022 particularly within the catastrophe exposed classes.
These losses included Hurricane Ian, the Eastern Australian Floods and various derecho events.
The underwriting result was also impacted by the Russia/Ukraine Conflict.
Given the nature of the Russia/Ukraine Conflict, the ultimate losses relating to the event are subject to a high degree of uncertainty.

data.data_quality_notes: All amounts reported in the native currency (USD). Opening reserves and prior-year movement taken from Technical Provisions note (claims outstanding table) which reports gross figures in $'000 and converted to millions here. The gross prior-year movement (88.663m) indicates an adverse strengthening, while the Managing Agent narrative refers to 'favourable attritional improvements' for 2020/prior years (this is a net/reinsurance-level commentary) - the narrative and gross movement therefore appear to describe different perspectives (gross vs net). Per instructions the gross movement was used. Some per-LOB prior-year movement amounts are not disclosed; lob_movements entries are directional inferences with low confidence.
